experiments.notes: v11 changes Anti-AFK priority. At each randomized 120-360s due tick, after the existing cast/channel guard, the module scans the Vanilla spellbook via GetSpellName. If Demon Armor is known it executes CastSpellByName('Demon Armor'); only characters without the spell fall back to SendChatMessage('.', 'SAY'). GUI/slash share the same enabled state. Setting 23 counts Anti-AFK actions and new setting 29 reports last action: 1 Demon Armor, 2 SAY fallback. No OS input or focus dependency.

Transient per-launch BG SOUND toggle for each multibox account. The updater patches only the selected child process in memory (0x14 off / 0x27 on); the on-disk EXE is untouched. LOW SPEC keeps its 800x600 graphics preset but preserves base audio and omits -nosound when BG SOUND is selected. External 5875 evidence: brndd/vanilla-tweaks sound-in-background patch and OctoLauncher patch table. UI follow-up: reserve a separate header row so the top description cannot cover column captions; middle column is explicitly labeled DŹWIĘK W TLE (BG SOUND).

Per-launch AUTO POSTAĆ 1 toggle in MULTIBOX. Updater passes WOW112_AUTOCHAR_FIRST=1 only to selected child processes. AutoLoginBridge waits for successful native login, then on the WoW window thread executes guarded GlueXML: CharacterSelect_SelectCharacter(1,1) followed by CharacterSelect_EnterWorld(). No SendInput/focus. 60s fail-safe window; one-shot Lua flag prevents repeated EnterWorld. Exact project evidence: current PARALLEL uses FrameScript_Execute 0x00704CD0 and object-manager 0x00B41414; external Vanilla GlueXML confirms first list slot is index 1. LOW reliability follow-up: readiness now keys off CharacterSelectUI (the actual GlueXML screen), not the CharacterSelect model frame. Selection and EnterWorld are split into two UI-thread polls; EnterWorld waits until CharacterSelect.selectedIndex==1 after UPDATE_SELECTED_CHARACTER. Poll window increased from 60s to 120s for slow LOW launches.
